Historic rooftop bar
Sep 2019 • Friends
Think Graham Greene, The Quiet American, war corespondents, journalists, military, Bar girls and hangers on congregating at the rooftop bar to drink, trade lies and watch the artillery battles across the Saigon River at night. Can’t see across the River now because of the new high rises, but the spirit remains the same. Drinks are still cold and reasonable, the band still rocking sixties American rock and roll. Worth the nostalgia!

Sunset Drinks and Dinner - Rooftop AMAZING
Sep 2018
Ohhhhhh THAT VIEW! Have your camera ready guys....This is one of a handful of MUST DO Rooftop experiences. Come just before dusk and watch the beautiful skyline of HCMC come to life in amazing colours and lights as daylight fades and nightfall elbows her way in. There are stunning views in 180 degree + directions. Not only is this spot an historic landmark architecturally in the city (think Quiet American, News Correspondents, Graham Greene, French Infantry wartime baracks, et al) but it is an incredible place to sit and have a bite, write a few socials (or postcards!), enjoy sumptuous cocktails and - in my case - listen to incredible live music performed wonderfully by a trio at no extra charge and adding such a memorable layer to an already "bucket-list" experience.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND/MUST DO

Old world charm with all modern amenities in a great location
Feb 2019
We only stayed for a couple of nights at the end of our trip so didn't get a chance to fully check out all the amenities that the hotel has to offer, however everything we did experience was great. The location, right on the banks of the Mekong is fantastic... minutes walk from lots of great places to eat, drink and explore. The room was clean, comfortable and quiet (even though we overlooked the main riverside road) with a balcony overlooking the river. The staff were helpful, friendly and accommodating and able to answer all our requests. The roof-top bar was a great spot for cocktails in the evening, with live music and a friendly vibe and breakfast (the only meal I had there) was comprehensive as well as tasty (big bonus points for having marmalade too!). I would definitely recommend a stay here and would return if I make it back to Ho Chi Minh City.

Went for the cocktails after a rainstorm
Sep 2018 • Friends
My friend and I decided to give this a try - first, we went during the weekend of Vietnamese Independence Day and also after dinner time/after a storm so perhaps it was more quiet than usual. We could only sit on the covered outdoor terrace area as the roof was shut off because of the rain so the view wasn't great - we were looking out at the Saigon River in the dark. It would be a lovely place for a quiet romantic drink, and they have very generous Gin and Tonics - more expensive than other parts of the city, but still very affordable. I would go again under better weather circumstances to see the views!

Magical Place
Sep 2016 • Business
My wife and I stayed at the Majestic Hotel for about 3-4 weeks while being transferred to Ho Chi Minh City for work. The old world French architectural was amazing. Each morning we went to the 5 floor restaurant for an outstanding breakfast. The highlight of our day. For dinner we visited the other restaurants. The views of HCM were great. Food was great too. The rooms had very high ceiling and were well updated and very comfortable. The staff are very friendly and helpful. We stay at the Majestic every time are traveling through HCM. This is the only place to stay in HCM.
